summary: Fidus Investment Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the adjournment of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders due to lack of quorum; no business was conducted. The meeting was reconvened for June 24, 2026, at the same location, with polls remaining open and record date unchanged. This is a procedural adjournment only, not a special situation event. The filing contains no terms, prices, premiums, or structural changes. It is a routine administrative update with no impact on corporate structure or control.
